
==Syntax==
<code><nowiki>{{random|max|seed|prime}}</nowiki></code>

Will generate a random number between 0 and max (inclusive) every time the page is loaded.

==Examples==

{| class="wikitable"
| Code
| Result
|-
| <nowiki>{{random}}</nowiki>
|         {{random}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random|1000}}</nowiki>
|         {{random|1000}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random|1000|872322935}}</nowiki>
|         {{random|1000|872322935}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random|1000|872322935|13}}</nowiki>
|         {{random|1000|872322935|13}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random|1}}</nowiki>
|         {{random|1}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random|0}}</nowiki>
|         {{random|0}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random|-2}}</nowiki>
|         {{random|-2}}
|-
| <nowiki>{{random|-1}}</nowiki>
|         {{random|-1}}
|-
|}
